name: Slapper Vs Runners 🖐️
desc:
Welcome to Slapper Vs Runners 🖐️
In this game you start as a Runner and race to the finish line to win! 🖐️

If you reach the end you become the Slapper and it’s your turn to stop the others from escaping!
Use your speed, timing, and strategy to avoid being slapped and reaching the Finish line. 🏁
